phenotype_specificity.statement: Elevated urinary GHB is stated for all patients (cohort-level). Exome sequencing was done, but the paper does not report results for other genes.

quotes.quote: As the gold-standard biomarker, elevated GHB was detected in all patients by urinary organic acids analysis.
Patients were diagnosed with SSADHD according to increased levels of GHB and the pathogenic variants in ALDH5A1, among whom patients 1 ~ 9 have been reported as clinical case series by us [13].

concerns: Methods say both parents were Sanger sequenced to determine the variants' locations, but no per-parent genotype is reported for any patient; the compound-heterozygous label is therefore stated, not shown, in the text.
Supplementary Table 3 has a "Frequency" column (e.g. 1/26) whose denominator is not defined; it looks like a within-study count, not a population frequency, and should not be read as population data.
Patient 12 is outside the earlier-reported patients 1 to 9, so no earlier report of this person is indicated by the paper.
Notation inconsistency for the other allele: Table 2 and Supplementary Table 1 write S510F as c.1529G > A, while the rest of the paper writes c.1529 C > T.
